Tick a criterion, with evidence that it is met

## Usage

```text
chainmail item criteria tick <id> <criterion-id> --evidence <text> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail item criteria tick it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 cr_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8c1 --evidence "receipt in cm1:work:INBOX:7:42"
```

## Flags

```text
      --evidence string   what shows the criterion is met, such as a ref or a link (required)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
